title: Retail energy price deregulation (Victoria)
summary: After the AEMC found retail energy competition effective, Victoria removed retail price controls on standing offers from 1 January 2009, moving to price monitoring by the Essential Services Commission.

instruments.title: Electricity Industry Act 2000
instruments.provisions: Reserve price-regulation power (s 13) conditioned on AEMC finding competition ineffective

commenced.what: Retail electricity and gas standing-offer price controls removed

direction_rationale: Removing regulated standing-offer prices is hypothesised to strengthen retailer entry and discounting (regulators judged competition effective), although outcomes for disengaged customers are contested.

industries.name: On Selling Electricity and Electricity Market Operation

comparison: NEM states that still had regulated retail prices (VIC 2009, SA 2013, NSW 2014, SEQ 2016; regional QLD, TAS, ACT still regulated)
price_series: Electricity; Gas and other household fuels
notes: 2017 Thwaites independent review argued outcomes were poor for disengaged customers.
